in_sanskrit.name: अर्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Belonging to the Aryans, the noble and virtuous people.

in_marathi.name: Aryil
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aryil is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'arya', which means noble, or 'il' meaning il or hail, which means valiant. In Hindu mythology, the Aryans were considered the noble people, and the name Aryil represents the bravery and nobility of an individual.
